rules.prepare:
# As in Debian, which switches all hardening off but the checks of format # strings. EXTRA_CFLAGS="-fno-stack-protector -fno-stack-clash-protection"
case "$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" in aarch64*) EXTRA_CFLAGS="$EXTRA_CFLAGS -mbranch-protection=none" ;; i?86*|x86_64*) EXTRA_CFLAGS="$EXTRA_CFLAGS -fcf-protection=none" ;; esac
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" bh_autotools_dev_update autoreconf -vfi
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" CFLAGS="$CFLAGS $EXTRA_CFLAGS" \ CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS $EXTRA_CFLAGS" \ CPPFLAGS="$CPPFLAGS -U_FORTIFY_SOURCE" \ "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-cxx-exceptions \ --disable-zlibdebuginfo \ --disable-tests
rules.install:
LIB_DIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/libunwind/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" SETJMP_LIB_DIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/libunwind-setjmp/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/libunwind" install
install -d -m 0755 "$SETJMP_LIB_DIR/pkgconfig" mv "$LIB_DIR"/libunwind-setjmp.* "$SETJMP_LIB_DIR/" mv "$LIB_DIR/pkgconfig/libunwind-setjmp.pc" "$SETJMP_LIB_DIR/pkgconfig/"
